responsibility: Implements LONGREAL conversion between fixed character arrays and numeric values by combining LongConv parsing/validation with ConvStringLong formatting. It translates format results and parsed values into caller buffers via DynamicStrings copy-out helpers, and chooses fixed versus floating rendering adaptively for RealToStr based on the destination array capacity.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for LongStr: it performs the actual array-based LONGREAL parsing and formatting via LongConv, ConvStringLong, and DynamicStrings copy-out helpers, whereas LongStr.def only defines the public conversion interface.
